Senses.Explanation: Knowing and deliberately transgressing names an intentional breach, whether Zhaozhou assigns it to karmic embodiment or Wuzu to Nantang’s calculated response. Wuzu faults Nantang’s knowing breach, Zhaozhou gives the phrase as the reason a dog enters its skin-bag, and Touzi applies it to the ancestral transmission itself.
